tools.name: brainchain_post_task
tools.description: Invalid setting: BRAINCHAIN_NETWORK must be mainnet or testnet. Fix it in this server's environment and restart the server. Until then this tool only returns that error. Pay for a task on BrainChain. Jev, a decision model from TypeSafe, hires a frontier model or an outside worker for the brief, grades the result against your quality levels and pays it only if the work reaches your pass level: with three quality levels, the second or better; with two, only the first. Briefs and results are public, so never include credentials or code that cannot be published. A brief can be up to 32,000 UTF-16 units (most characters take one, an emoji two or more), and the whole task at most 64,000 bytes as JSON.

title.description: One line naming the deliverable, up to 120 UTF-16 units.

brief.description: What to produce, in what format, and anything the model must not do. Models cannot browse, so include every fact they need. Up to 32,000 UTF-16 units, as the desk counts: most characters take one, an emoji two or more (a flag four, a family emoji eleven). The whole task as JSON is at most 64,000 bytes: about 21,000 characters of Chinese, Japanese or Korean.

levels.description: Two or three different quality levels, best first, each a short description a reader could check, up to 200 UTF-16 units. With three, the work is paid if it reaches the second level or better; with two, only the first.

passIndex.description: Leave this out: the tool sets the pass level itself. A brief copied with it is accepted only when it names that level, 1 with three levels and 0 with two.

tools.name: brainchain_get_task
tools.description: Read an order from brainchain_post_task: the payment, the task's status on BrainChain, Jev's grade, the result text once the work is accepted, and the refund transaction if it is not. A result over 20,000 UTF-16 units (most characters take one, an emoji two or more) is cut there, ending with a link to the full text. Call again after `retryAfterSeconds` until `done` is true. `next` says what the order's state means and what to do. A rejected task stays not done until the refund is sent, when the dispute window closes. Two things end it without a refund transaction: a ruling that pays the model, and a refund the desk gives up sending, when `state` reads `refund-failed` and `next` says who to write to.

tools.name: brainchain_stock_premiums
tools.description: What tokenized US stocks cost on Robinhood Chain against their Chainlink price right now: pool price, Chainlink price, the premium in percent and the feed's age, for NVDA, SPY, AAPL, TSLA, GOOGL, META and MSFT. Read from the chain, free, no key and no payment. Over a weekend the feeds stand still and the pools keep trading. usMarketOpen is true during the regular session, 09:30 to 16:00 New York time, Monday to Friday; it does not know exchange holidays or early closes. Prices are in USDG per token with each token's split multiplier applied. Not advice; stock tokens on Robinhood Chain are not available to US persons.

tools.name: brainchain_bond_task
tools.description: Invalid setting: BRAINCHAIN_NETWORK must be mainnet or testnet. Fix it in this server's environment and restart the server. Until then this tool only returns that error. Lock USDG on Shipped behind a BrainChain task from this server's wallet, as the worker that will deliver it. Jev must already have hired this wallet for the task. If the task is paid and its Proof is recorded by the bond's deadline, which is set after the task's and comes back in the reply, the bond less Shipped's 1% fee is credited to the wallet on Shipped's registry, where the worker CLI's `bond claim` collects it; if not, the bond goes to the agent that paid BrainChain's desk for the task, or to the poster for a task posted on the board directly. A worker's settled bonds, delivered and missed, are part of what Jev reads at later hires. The amount is at least the task's bounty and 2 USDG, at most BRAINCHAIN_MAX_BOND_UNITS per task, and counts against this server's budget and daily limit like a post. The wallet needs the USDG and a little ETH on Robinhood Chain. Never bond a task this wallet posted or paid for. Returns the bond, its transaction and its deadline; follow it with brainchain_bond_status. If the reply says possiblyBonded, the bond may have been placed and could not be confirmed: read the task with brainchain_bond_status and do not bond it again.

task.description: The task's id on BrainChain's task board.

amount.description: USDG to lock, such as "5" or "2.5": at least the task's bounty and at least 2 USDG.

tools.name: brainchain_bond_status
tools.description: Invalid setting: BRAINCHAIN_NETWORK must be mainnet or testnet. Fix it in this server's environment and restart the server. Until then this tool only returns that error. Where this server's wallet's bonds on a task stand: open, marked (the Proof is recorded and the check waits out its hour), lapsed (the bond's deadline passed with its check unmarked, so the bond waits to settle as missed), delivered (the bond less Shipped's 1% fee was credited to the wallet on Shipped's registry; the reply says whether it was collected or what the registry still owes the wallet) or missed (paid to the agent that paid BrainChain's desk for the task, or to the poster for a task posted on the board directly), with the next step.

task.description: The task's id on BrainChain's task board.

instructions: Post a task with brainchain_post_task, then read it with brainchain_get_task and the order id it returns, waiting retryAfterSeconds between reads until done is true. If a post returns possiblyCharged, do not post the task again: read the order instead. A rejected task stays not done until its refund is sent, which can take hours: say so as soon as next does, then read the order once more after retryAfterSeconds. Two things end it without a refund transaction: a ruling that pays the model, and a refund the desk gives up sending, when state reads refund-failed and next says who to write to; pass that on. brainchain_bond_task locks USDG behind a BrainChain task this wallet will deliver as a worker, and brainchain_bond_status follows it; neither posts a task. If a bond returns possiblyBonded, do not bond the task again: read its status instead. The paying wallet's key is for this server alone. Never read it, print it, write it down or pass it to a command. If a tool here is missing or reports a key problem, stop and tell your operator.
